A '''vindinax''' was a type of dangerous predator that originated on a [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], on which it was at the top of the food chain. The vindinax were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] and had long tails, and they also had dark green, [[Chitin/Legends|chitinous]] carapaces that led some people to believe that the [[Species/Legends|species]] was [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] in nature. However, some of the creatures' other traits, such as their forward-facing [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], their claws and their sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] suggested that they were [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]]. A number of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] studied the species and came to the conclusion that the vindinax's natural habitat was either a forest or a jungle, because the creatures appeared to favor hiding in high-up places, from which they would pounce on their prey.

At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] obtained a captive vindinax and planned to sell the creature to a [[Zoo/Legends|zoo]] on a planet in the Unknown Regions. However, en-route to his destination the merchant landed on [[Iol Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Iol system/Legends|Iol system]]. The creature was confiscated by the port's customs [[Officer/Legends|officers]], because the merchant lacked the paperwork required to be able to transport the creature, and they fined the merchant for bringing a potential threat to the station. The customs officers placed the vindinax's shipping container in one of the station's cargo bays and they subsequently did not take good care of the creature. Desperate for food, the creature broke out of its container and ate the station's entire crew. However, the vindinax's victims were not sufficient to sustain it and when a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] landed on Iol Station several days later, the creature attacked them in one of the station's storage rooms.
